subject: CLOSE statement
notes: CLOSE F1 F2 F3 with F2 unopened gives per-file 00/42/00 (GR1) with F1 and F3 provably closed by re-OPEN; CLOSE F1 F1 gives 00 then 42; a USE declarative's RESUME AT NEXT STATEMENT on the F2 leg resumes at the F3 leg. RE-MEASURED under kb/Work PB893: each implicit CLOSE raises its GR5 condition at its END (after the close completed), so a RESUME NEXT STATEMENT out of EC-REPORT-NOT-TERMINATED resumes at the next implicit CLOSE and nothing of the current one remains to run (pb893_close_report_completes: CLOSE RPT OTH, declarative RESUME NEXT -> OTH closed, END ST=00 OS=00). PB893's premise that the report file must stay open was contradicted by GR5 ('the CLOSE statement for that file is completed'); the defect it pointed at was the raise ORDER, fixed under GR-14.9.6.4-5.
